title: DRep Rationale Kit
body: Problem: DReps need repeatable rationale drafting for governance actions without relying on uncited summaries. Request: a governance action asks for an open documentation and tooling kit for vote rationale templates. Impact: DReps can explain decisions with consistent caveats, source references, and human accountability. Feasibility: the proposal gives milestone dates, reusable templates, and a small maintainer team. Risk: rationale drafts may be mistaken for recommendations if the interface does not force a human-selected stance. Missing evidence: the proposal needs a stronger plan for measuring whether DReps reuse the templates.
